verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents outbound webhooks with a `webhook-id` idempotency header, opt-in per-account webhook signing, and a `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED` webhook whose payload carries the screening result, so a system can react to screening outcomes without polling. The evidence only shows a completion-type event, not the full created/processing/verified/requires-input lifecycle the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented intermediate lifecycle event types (created, processing, requires-input), details of the signature verification scheme, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
